contract.task_clause:
Experimenter A uses a very small test charge qo, and experimenter B uses a test charge 2qo to measure an electric field produced by two parallel plates. A finds a field that is
Option A: greater than the field found by B
Option B: the same as the field found by B
Option C: less than the field found by B
Option D: either greater or less than the field found by B, depending on the accelerations of the test charges
